sense.text:
Who you spend your time with can change the person you become. Spend the day in a fish market and you come out smelling like fish, though you never sold one; stand in a perfume shop and the scent is on your clothes, though you never bought any. The environment rubs off on you whether you like it or not. So know who you have in your circle, because it will affect who you become.

“He that walketh with wise men shall be wise”. Wise men are men that understand the law, men that apply these scriptures to their life. Walk with them and you will be wise.

“But a companion of fools shall be destroyed.” If fools are who you are around all week, you will end up destroyed, because you will do the same dumb, stupid things those fools do. A lot of the time we put ourselves in the wrong environment, around old friends and toxic people, and that same toxic scent ends up on you. Even inside here some of you are not right. That is the wisdom for the week, to carry all through the week.

precepts.why:
“All flesh consorteth according to kind, and a man will cleave to his like.” If you are in a bad environment and you are comfortable there, comfortable around negative people, it means you are just like the people you are around. If you are trying to change, you have to separate yourself from negativity, from negative people and bad environments, or you will get caught up.

“What fellowship hath the wolf with the lamb? so the sinner with the godly.” You are a lamb fellowshipping with wolves: dudes talking about sticking people up, about the club, about sports and all this crap. What fellowship has a wolf with a sheep? If you are godly and around sinners all the time, it is going to rub off on you; the sinner will entice you. That is why the companion of fools is destroyed.

sense.text: The disciples came to Christ privately, “saying, Tell us, when shall these things be? and what shall be the sign of thy coming, and of the end of the world?” What signs must we look for before Christ returns, and for the end of the world? Here Christ begins to explain to the apostles what to look for. When we say we are living in the last days, the end of the world, the time when Christ is about to return, this is what we mean.

“For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom”: we see nations and kingdoms rising up against each other right now. “And there shall be famines, and pestilences, and earthquakes, in divers places”: earthquakes all over, in different places. Before Christ returns there will be wars, and a lot of earthquakes.

And we are seeing it. A 7.2 magnitude earthquake hit Peru on the 20th of August 2026. Ten days before that a 7.4 struck Colombia, collapsing buildings and trapping people across many cities. Eight major earthquakes in five months, in Indonesia, Japan, the Philippines, Venezuela, Mexico and Colombia, one after another, and the world says this does not usually happen. The reporters are calling it earthquake season. It is not earthquake season. It is the sign that Christ is about to return, the sign that we are living in the end. It might be ten years, fifteen, twenty or twenty-five, but it is not long again, and as things progress we will know how close it is.

Those of you with weak faith, who think this book is a fairy tale, this should increase your faith. The Lord said it, and it is coming to pass.

“All these are the beginning of sorrows.” That is the time we are living in. Much sorrow, plagues, disaster, destruction and death is coming on this earth, and we are at the beginning of it. The beginning means it is going to get worse: the earthquakes, the wars, the pestilence and the famine will increase and intensify. Pay attention, and don't be in la-la land.

“Knowing this first, that no prophecy of the scripture is of any private interpretation.” There is no personal interpretation, where I read it this way and you read it that way. There is one way to understand the Bible, and that is by the spirit of God that comes in you and makes you understand it. Know this first, before you start reading.

“For the prophecy came not in old time by the will of man: but holy men of God spake as they were moved by the Holy Ghost.” The spirit of the Lord came into holy men, and they wrote down what the Lord showed them would take place in the future: what will happen to the children of Israel, the kingdoms that will rise up on this earth, and the events before Christ returns.

All the prophets saw Christ's return, and most of them saw the antichrist; they saw Lucifer. But when they wrote about him, they did not call him the antichrist. They all spoke about that last kingdom that will be set up on the earth and will fight against Christ when he returns. They all saw the same thing and explained it in different words.

“Little children, it is the last time: and as ye have heard that antichrist shall come”. John is the only one in the Bible who calls a system or a person the antichrist. Peter didn't, and the prophets didn't. “Antichrist shall come” is future: John is speaking first and foremost of a system, a government, that shall come in the future and be against Christ.

“Even now are there many antichrists”. Anti means against. Even in John's time there were many people against Christ, so the antichrist was already at work. The antichrist is many; it is not one person. We are not waiting on some little boy with 666 on his head called Damien, like in the Omen movies; that is the brainwashing they do to you. The antichrist is already here.

“They went out from us, but they were not of us; for if they had been of us, they would no doubt have continued with us”. That is one form of antichrist: men who were among the apostles, who left them and went out teaching against the apostles' teaching. The teaching of the apostles was the teaching of Christ, so they were against Christ.

They taught that the resurrection had already taken place. They taught that you must be circumcised. That goes back to the Pharisees, who pushed first and foremost that men must be circumcised after the manner of Moses, the old covenant of animal sacrifice, and not Christ. Circumcision itself is a law we have to keep; the antichrist doctrine was pushing it before Christ. Those are antichrist doctrines.

precepts.why:
Another level of antichrist in the time of the apostles. Being let go, the apostles “reported all that the chief priests and elders had said unto them”. The chief priests and the elders, the religious leaders, had threatened them not to teach any more in Christ's name.

They prayed, “Lord, thou art God”, and remembered what was said by David: “Why did the heathen rage, and the people imagine vain things?” David saw the antichrist. The people imagine lies. “The kings of the earth stood up, and the rulers were gathered together against the Lord, and against his Christ.” The kings and the rulers are the political systems, gathered against Christ. That is antichrist.

And who were they? “Both Herod, and Pontius Pilate, with the Gentiles, and the people of Israel, were gathered together”. Herod was an Edomite, a white man set up by Rome to rule Jerusalem; Pontius Pilate was another ruler set up by Rome; and the people of Israel here are the religious leaders. Herod killed thousands of black babies to keep Christ from being born, because he knew Christ is the king, and when Christ rules, the white man will not be ruling any more. Ever since Christ was born, the antichrist system has been against him.

And how did the apostles die? Rome. Rome crucified us and put us in their coliseum for sport, with lions ripping us apart, under Nero. Rome is the antichrist. Even the scholars have known for a long time that the enemy in Revelation is not some human antichrist coming in the future, but the empire of Rome and its emperor. The religious leaders of Israel trusted in Rome and followed Rome; they said that if they left Christ alone, Rome would come and take away their seat and their authority. The antichrist was set up ever since the time of Rome.

So they prayed, “And now, Lord, behold their threatenings: and grant unto thy servants, that with all boldness they may speak thy word”. That is what we must pray for today, because that antichrist system is here today.

sense.text: John said the apostles had heard that antichrist should come. Where did he hear that someone would come against Christ? He heard it from Christ, here. The disciples asked him, “what shall be the sign of thy coming, and of the end of the world?” What must we look for before you come?
“Take heed that no man deceive you.” Don't let anybody deceive you in the end.

“For many shall come in my name, saying, I am Christ; and shall deceive many.” Remember, the antichrist is many. Many shall come in Christ's name saying, I am Christ, I am Christian, I am the people of Christ, the anointed. This is the forming of Christianity, the false religion. Christ warned the apostles: before I return, someone will come on this earth and say that they are me and my people, and they will deceive everybody on the earth. That is a sign that the end is about to come.

Christianity did this in the 1400s, during the Renaissance. They changed over all the black icons all over Europe and set themselves up as Christ's anointed ones, as the people of God, as the Jew. Christianity could not be set up unless they also set themselves up as the people of God; that is why you cannot separate Christianity and Judaism. They had to put white people in the land and say they are the Jews, and erase the history of the real Jews, to give Christianity any validity. A man like Jake Lang says it plainly: Jesus was a white Jewish man like him, and God would not make himself not white. That is what Christ was talking about.

This whole religious system you see set up is part of the antichrist system, because Christianity is against the true Christ, and Judaism is against the true Christ. Tell them Jesus Christ is black and they don't want to hear it. We are the true anointed, the true believers of Christ, and the world calls us a hate group and black extremists for saying we are the Jews. Christianity is very racist: it is built on white supremacy, on murder and bloodshed.

precepts.why:
“And he opened his mouth in blasphemy against God, to blaspheme his name”. To come in Christ's name saying I am Christ is to blaspheme his name, because they are not the Christ of the Bible. To call themselves Christians is blasphemy; to say God would not make himself anything but white is blasphemy; to call themselves the white angels is blasphemy. Blasphemy is telling a lie against the Bible.

Do white people love Jesus? They love him as long as he looks like them. Tell them Jesus Christ is a black man and you see the anger in their face: Jesus cannot be black. They hate black people and they hate Christ. A white preacher says the black people in heaven won't be trying to steal his kids' bikes, that he will meet black people in heaven but doesn't want them living here. That is Christianity. That is the antichrist system and the false prophets, pushing that false Christ, that false Jesus. All those religious leaders are against the Christ of the Bible.

“Now there were in the church that was at Antioch certain prophets and teachers; as Barnabas, and Simeon that was called Niger”. The prophets and teachers were called Niger, and Niger means black. The white man turned that word into a derogatory word, but the prophets were called black right through history, the same way we are called it today. Nothing has changed.

If the prophets were black, then Christ was black.

sense.text: “Beloved, believe not every spirit, but try the spirits whether they are of God”. Don't believe every spirit; try them to see if they are of God, “because many false prophets are gone out into the world.” There are many false prophets in this world.

“Every spirit that confesseth that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is of God”. In that day the religious leaders were denying that Jesus Christ, the son of God, came in the flesh, and John rebuked them, letting them know they were not of God.

Bring it up to today. To say Jesus Christ came in the flesh means he was born of a mother and a father; he had an earthly body, so he came from an ethnic group of people. Flesh represents nationality: you can tell a Chinese man, a white man, a black man when you see him in the flesh. Christ came from the so-called Negroes, and his skin was black.

Does it matter what color Malcolm X was, or Martin Luther King? Yes, it matters, because they came fighting for the struggle of a race of people. It is the same with Christ. Christ came to redeem his people from their sins, so the question is, who are Christ's people? If you can change Christ's people, you can change Christ's teachings.

“And every spirit that confesseth not that Jesus Christ is come in the flesh is not of God: and this is that spirit of antichrist”. Back then they were the antichrist. Today, Christianity does not teach that Jesus Christ came in the flesh; the white man changed Jesus, and he does not teach that Christ came from the so-called Negroes he enslaved. If you don't teach that Jesus Christ was a black man, you are not of God. You are the antichrist; you are against Christ.

Some of these dumb Christians say Christ had no color, that Christ is a spirit. You dumb, stupid Christians, you are of that antichrist: you hate yourself, you hate your people, and you hate your king. Christ was black just like you; not just regular black, blacker than black.

precepts.why:
“His head and his hairs were white like wool, as white as snow”. White people don't have white woolly hair; their hair is straight. Christ had white woolly hair, and woolly is kinky. Look it up in the old dictionary, and it says of Negroes.

“And his eyes were as a flame of fire”, “And his feet like unto fine brass, as if they burned in a furnace”. Christ's feet were like fine brass burnt in a furnace. Christ is a very dark-skinned man. So if you don't confess that Jesus Christ came in the flesh, that he is a black man, you are the antichrist, against Christ.

Some Christians say it doesn't matter what Christ looks like, as long as you have the love of Jesus; I don't worship white Jesus, I don't have any images in my mind. But if it is not a black man in your mind when you pray in the name of Christ, you are worshipping Satan. Do you think white people have a black man in their mind when they pray? Hell no.

“Babylon is fallen, is fallen, that great city, because she made all nations drink of the wine of the wrath of her fornication.” Then the third angel: “If any man worship the beast and his image”. What image? The white image of Christ, the image everybody on the earth worships, the image of the false prophets, the antichrist religion. They would not put Christ up as he really looks, a black man; they changed his image, and they teach another Jesus.

“And receive his mark in his forehead, or in his hand”: his mark is his lies. You believe that the people they put in the land over there are Jews; you believe his democracy; you believe you don't have to keep God's laws any more; his Christmas, his Easter. Believe and follow those things, and “The same shall drink of the wine of the wrath of God, which is poured out without mixture into the cup of his indignation”.

So it does matter what image Christ is, because the scripture says someone will set up a false image of Christ on the earth that everybody worships. Who has set it up? Not us; we show from the scriptures that Christ is a black man. It is the antichrist system, the beast. So to the Christians who say we don't know what we are talking about: what is the image of the beast that the whole world is going to worship? If it is not that white image of Christ the world worships today, you explain what it is. Christ is going to return and destroy everyone that worships it.

“As the serpent beguiled Eve through his subtilty, so your minds should be corrupted from the simplicity that is in Christ.” The serpent tricked Eve through his trickery. What is the simplicity that is in Christ? One of the most simple things about Christ is that he is black. Christ came from Judah, and the Jews are black. He died for our sins, for Israel, and he taught the laws of God. Keep the commandments to get salvation; Christ is black; it is only for the twelve tribes. That is the whole Bible. There are levels to Christ that people don't understand, but his image and his teachings are simple.

Christianity overcomplicates it. Wool doesn't mean wool, it's symbolic; you can't keep God's commandments, they are done away with. They run to Paul, because they know Paul is hard to understand, and that is the only way they can confuse the Negroes. Ask anybody what color Christ is, what people he came from, and the whole world is confused about the simple thing.

“For if he that cometh preacheth another Jesus, whom we have not preached”. Paul warned us because he understood that someone would come and preach another Jesus. That other Jesus is the image of the beast in Revelation 14:9; it is the many who come in Christ's name, saying, I am Christ. The white man, Edom, came in the name of Christ and taught another Christ. Edom is against Christ. The apostles never followed any man with blonde hair and blue eyes.

“Or if ye receive another spirit, which ye have not received, or another gospel, which ye have not accepted”. When you follow Christianity you receive another spirit: the spirit on these Roman Catholics, a homosexual spirit, an adulterous spirit, because they tell you that you don't have to keep God's laws, the law is done away with. With that spirit comes another gospel, different from what Christ taught. That is the false prophets. Christianity is antichrist. “Ye might well bear with him”: bear with him, meaning correct him.

sense.text:
Paul also speaks of the antichrist, but by another name; all the prophets say the same thing in different words. “Let no man deceive you by any means”: the same thing Christ said. “For that day shall not come”: the day of the Lord, the day the apostles asked Christ about, the sign of his coming and of the end.

“Except there come a falling away first”: Israel had to fall away into captivity first.

“And that man of sin be revealed, the son of perdition”. Instead of saying antichrist, Paul says the man of sin and the son of perdition, and he is speaking of the same people John spoke of. The man of sin is Esau, Edom, the border of wickedness, the people God hates. They have to be revealed as the wicked, genocidal race of people they really are: that they are not the people of God, not Christians, not a godly race.

Perdition means destruction: eternal damnation, total destruction. The son of perdition is not one person; it is a race, a people. It is the son God created just to destroy him.

“Who opposeth and exalteth himself above all that is called God, or that is worshipped”. To oppose is to be against, anti; and Satan means to oppose, to be against. This is letting you know who he is: the devil. He exalts himself against the true Christ and opposes him.

“So that he as God sitteth in the temple of God, shewing himself that he is God.” Who does this? The white man, the son of perdition, the son God created to destroy. He set himself up as God and as Christ, and he set himself up as the people of God. All those images he has set up all over the world say, God looks like me.

It goes into his technology too; he really thinks he is a god. Sister, you don't like how God made you, the white man will make your body bigger; you lost your virginity, he can give it back. That's your god. But in the end you are going to die in the lake of fire.

“Remember ye not, that, when I was yet with you, I told you these things?” “And now ye know what withholdeth that he might be revealed in his time.” What withholds Christ from returning: the man of sin has to be revealed in his time, and his time is the time we are living in right now. Right now we are revealing him. That genocidal race of wicked people is being revealed.

“For the mystery of iniquity doth already work”. Paul calls the antichrist the mystery of iniquity. Why is it a mystery that this man is sinful and evil? Because he has tricked the whole world. The whole world thinks he is righteous and holy. He has to be revealed in his time, and that is now: the white man is being revealed as the wicked, the children of Satan, a genocidal, evil race of people, with nothing to do with Christ or Christ's people. He is being revealed by us.

The mystery of iniquity that was already at work in Paul's day was Rome. That is why the antichrist system was set up back then. Rome killed our king; they killed him for treason, because Christ said he is a king. Rome killed the apostles, and many of our people died in Rome. The mystery of iniquity is the antichrist system, the antichrist government, the beast.

“Only he who now letteth will let, until he be taken out of the way.” It says he, but it is a race of people; the apostles spoke in hidden talk.

“And then shall that Wicked be revealed”. The Wicked is the mystery of iniquity, the man of sin, the son of perdition, the antichrist: Lucifer, the son of the morning. “Whom the Lord shall consume with the spirit of his mouth, and shall destroy with the brightness of his coming”. It starts with us teaching; then, when Christ returns, he is going to destroy them.

“Even him, whose coming is after the working of Satan”. The white man coming into power and ruling this earth is after the working of Satan. How do you think the white man knows how to make all these weapons, this phone, all this technology? It is not God's technology; it is Satan's. Satan gave him the power to create guns, weapons of mass destruction, all the technology you enjoy, and the cars you ride in comfortable under the AC. All of it destroys the earth, and when Christ returns it will be done away with. We won't need any of it; we will speak to one another telepathically.

“With all power and signs and lying wonders”: the power, the signs and the lying wonders go into his technologies.

“And with all deceivableness of unrighteousness”: the religions he set up, built on deceit. Jesus Christ is not a white man, and they are not the people of God. Follow it, and you will drink from the wrath of Christ when he returns.

“In them that perish”: those of you who are going to die will die because you were deceived: deceived to think Jesus Christ is white, that the people in the land are the real Jews, that you are a Gentile; deceived to think Christ was born on December 25th and to celebrate Christmas and Easter and all the wicked things the white man has set up in his system, the antichrist system.

“Because they received not the love of the truth”. We teach you the truth and you don't want to listen. You call us a hate group and say we are hateful because we speak the truth. That is why you are going to die.

precepts.why:
What is the falling away? Slavery, captivity. Before Christ returns, Israel had to fall away, and that falling away goes into a lot, even into us forgetting our nationality.

“And they shall fall by the edge of the sword, and shall be led away captive into all nations”. We fell by the edge of the sword, and we were led away as slaves into all nations. That is what happened to us. That day shall not come until the twelve tribes have fallen away into captivity.

Who is the man of sin, the son of perdition? “And I hated Esau, and laid his mountains and his heritage waste for the dragons of the wilderness.” “Whereas Edom saith, We are impoverished, but we will return and build the desolate places”: that is what the white man did in the 1400s. It is called the Renaissance, the rebirth: the rebirth of the white race.

“Thus saith the Lord of hosts, They shall build, but I will throw down”. When the Lord returns, he is going to destroy all the cities Esau has set up on this earth.

“And they shall call them, The border of wickedness”. The day is us, in these last days: the prophets calling Esau the border of wickedness. When we call them that, we are revealing them, letting them know that they are the wicked and everything they are doing is evil. That is the man of sin being revealed in 2 Thessalonians: the prophets revealing that Esau is the wicked of the earth.

“And, The people against whom the Lord hath indignation for ever.” It is not just Esau; it is his whole race, his people. God hates that people forever. The man of sin and the son of perdition is Esau, Edom, and it has to be revealed that white people are not the people of God.

The son of perdition is the son God created just to destroy him. “And Cain said unto the Lord, My punishment is greater than I can bear.” Cain committed that murder and started following Satan, and this goes into the son of destruction.

“Behold, thou hast driven me out this day from the face of the earth”. Was Cain still on the earth at that time? Yes. So he was not driven off the face of the earth then. This is future prophecy: when Christ comes, the white man will be driven off the face of the earth, and there will be no more white people on the earth. That is the judgment on Cain from the beginning for what he did, and it passes on to his descendants, his race, his people, for all the evil that murderous race has done on this earth.

“Hath not the potter power over the clay, of the same lump to make one vessel unto honour, and another unto dishonour?” The vessel unto honour was Jacob. The vessel unto dishonour was Esau, which is Cain come back as Esau.

“What if God, willing to shew his wrath, and to make his power known”: God wants to show his wrath and make his power known, so that people will respect him. So he “endured with much longsuffering the vessels of wrath fitted to destruction”. The vessels of wrath are the son of perdition, the whole race. The Lord endures, meaning he allows. Ever ask why God lets white people keep doing all this evil and never steps in? Because he is enduring it: I will deal with you in the end. They are going to pay for everything they did and everything they are doing. There is a God.

They are fitted to destruction; God created them to destroy them, and perdition means destruction. The white man is fitted to be destroyed.

“And that he might make known the riches of his glory on the vessels of mercy”: the vessels of mercy are the twelve tribes of Israel, you blacks and Hispanics.

sense.text: “And I saw when the Lamb opened one of the seals, and I heard, as it were the noise of thunder, one of the four beasts saying, Come and see.” These are the seven seals, and this is the first.

“And I saw, and behold a white horse: and he that sat on him had a bow; and a crown was given unto him: and he went forth conquering, and to conquer.” This goes into the 1400s. Who is it that comes back on the white horse? Christ; the white horse represents pure righteousness. So the one on this white horse went forth conquering in the name of righteousness. This is how Christianity was spread throughout the earth.

The papal bulls of the 1400s and 1500s: the Pope authorized slavery. The doctrine of discovery said that anywhere in the world the people did not follow Christianity, you could take their land and enslave them. Britain, Spain and Portugal didn't come teaching love; they came conquering, on that white horse, in the name of Christ. They called themselves Christians, and they murdered, killed, pillaged and raped. Christianity is the bloodiest religion on the earth; to set it up they had to rape, murder and kill and force it down our throats. So don't tell me anything about Christianity or white Jesus. Why would Jesus send the Pope to enslave you, and to colonize Africa and teach them white Jesus?

Some argue that Christianity was in Africa before. The teachings of Christ were in Africa before: there were Israelite communities there that understood Christ, and the white man went over there to conquer and destroy that teaching. What the white man brought in the 1400s was something new. And in whose name did he come conquering under the first seal? In Christ's name: many shall come in my name.

Now to make it plain what the beast is, and what the antichrist is. “The fourth beast shall be the fourth kingdom upon earth, which shall be diverse from all kingdoms, and shall devour the whole earth”. The East Indians enslaved by Britain, the Japanese, Pakistan, the whole of Africa: everybody was conquered and colonized by the white man and taught Christianity. That is what the fourth beast did.

The fourth beast is Rome, and America and Europe are an extension of Rome. That is why the antichrist system was set up ever since Rome; they were against Christ even when he came. We are living in the end of the fourth beast, which is America and Europe. When the Bible says they will worship the image of the beast, it is the fourth beast: the Caucasian race, that empire, the Europeans. When the Bible talks about the antichrist, it is talking about the fourth beast, and you Negroes that follow the beast have the mark of the white race. Edom is the fourth beast. People read this as a mystery. It is not: the fourth beast is the white man. It began with Rome, and this is the ending of their kingdom.

“And shall tread it down, and break it in pieces”: that is what Rome, Europe and America did to all nations.

“And the ten horns out of this kingdom are ten kings that shall arise”: the ten horns are Europe. “And another shall rise after them”: that is America, Lucifer, son of the morning, the kingdom that rose out of those ten horns. “And he shall be diverse from the first, and he shall subdue three kings”: he fought with Britain, Spain and France.

“And he shall speak great words against the most High”. It says he, but it is a nation: America. The great words he speaks against God are that he is a Christian nation, that they are the Jews. All the evil you see America doing and saying is great words against God.

“And shall wear out the saints of the most High”: America wore us out in slavery. When something is worn out, like an old Nike sneaker, you can't tell what it is any more. The white man wore the children of Israel out so badly that we don't know who we are as a nation, a people; we call ourselves Afro-American, African American and all kinds of names.

“And think to change times and laws”: he has changed God's laws. It says think, because the prophets are going to come and reverse what he has done on the earth.

“And they shall be given into his hand until a time and times and the dividing of time.” We were given into his hand for 350 years. So the fourth beast is Rome, Europe and America: white people. They are the antichrist, the man of sin we keep reading about.

“And I stood upon the sand of the sea, and saw a beast rise up out of the sea, having seven heads and ten horns”. This is the same beast we keep reading about: if any man worship the beast and his image. It is Europe, white people, the fourth beast; the last kingdom to rule this earth, the antichrist that will fight against Christ when he returns, and he will destroy them. The seven heads and ten horns go into its governments, the different nations that rose up among them.

“And upon his horns ten crowns, and upon his heads the name of blasphemy.” Every one of his heads blasphemed God. Portugal and all of them pushed that western Christian garbage, that Jesus Christ is white, and all of them colonized and enslaved us. Blasphemy means lies.

“And I saw one of his heads as it were wounded to death; and his deadly wound was healed: and all the world wondered after the beast.” This is Rome. Rome fell in 193 A.D. and came back in the 1400s: that is the wound being healed. When they came back into power they started conquering, erasing all the dark images, enslaving the Israelites and destroying our nationality and the history of who we are.

“And they worshipped the dragon which gave power unto the beast”. The dragon is Satan, and Satan gave the white man his power. So when you worship the white man, you are worshipping Satan.

“And they worshipped the beast, saying, Who is like unto the beast? who is able to make war with him?” There is nobody like the white man, and nobody is able to make war with him, because Satan gave him the power to create guns and weapons nobody can fight against. He will drop an atomic bomb and destroy you.

“And there was given unto him a mouth speaking great things and blasphemies”. We are reading about the antichrist: he speaks blasphemies. “And he opened his mouth in blasphemy against God, to blaspheme his name, and his tabernacle, and them that dwell in heaven.” He blasphemed God, and those of us that dwell in heaven, the angels.

“And it was given unto him to make war with the saints, and to overcome them”. He made war with us and overcame us. “And power was given him over all kindreds”. This goes into colonization and slavery: he had to make war with us and conquer us before he could push the lie that he is a Jew, that he is the people of God and the Christians. Slavery wasn't a coincidence. Slavery was war. The fourth beast that is ruling the earth is against Christ.

“And it shall come to pass in the day that the Lord shall give thee rest from thy sorrow, and from thy fear, and from the hard bondage wherein thou wast made to serve”, “That thou shalt take up this proverb against the king of Babylon”. Lucifer is not an angel. When we are given rest from our hard bondage, we will be speaking against America. The king of Babylon here is America, and Lucifer is the king of Babylon: mystery Babylon the great, that great whore.

“And say, How hath the oppressor ceased! the golden city ceased!” Lucifer is also called the oppressor, and the golden city. Golden city, because America is rich.
“The Lord hath broken the staff of the wicked, and the sceptre of the rulers.” It is talking about rulers: a city, a country of rulers, a government. America, the king of Babylon.

“Hell from beneath is moved for thee to meet thee at thy coming”: this tells how Lucifer will be destroyed, how America will be cut down to the ground. “It stirreth up the dead for thee, even all the chief ones of the earth”: the chief ones of the earth are the kings of the earth. “It hath raised up from their thrones all the kings of the nations.” All the kings of the nations are going to rise up against Lucifer to destroy him. And Lucifer is America: the antichrist, the fourth beast, the son of perdition.

So the antichrist is the fourth beast, the whole system that is set up and ruling the earth: the son of perdition, the mystery of iniquity, the man of sin, the white man. Now, who is Lucifer?

The world says Lucifer was a beautiful, glorious angel who, out of pride, wanted to rival God and was cast down from heaven to become Satan. That is bull crap. Lucifer has not been cast down yet.

“How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning! how art thou cut down to the ground”. Heaven here is not the literal heaven. There are the heavens where the Father is, which is paradise; there is the heaven of the sky and space; and there is heaven as a place of authority. To fall from heaven is to fall from rulership. This is a future prophecy of America being destroyed.

Why is America called Lucifer? Lucifer is a Latin word, and the book of Isaiah was written in Hebrew; the Hebrew word means shining one, and the other translations read morning star, day star, shining one. Only the King James puts Lucifer there. The translators understood something most people don't: they put that word there to make a distinction between this morning star, the king of Babylon, and the morning star we read of all through the scriptures, which is Christ.

“Which didst weaken the nations!” Verse 9 tells how he will be weakened and cut down.

“They that see thee shall narrowly look upon thee, and consider thee, saying, Is this the man”. Lucifer is called a man. Not an angel, not a fallen angel: the man of sin, the son of perdition, the antichrist, the fourth beast.

“That made the earth to tremble, that did shake kingdoms”: he made the earth tremble and shook kingdoms by dropping bombs on other countries. Some say America has technology, HAARP, that can cause earthquakes. That needs more research, but if it is so, the Lord let them make it, the same way he let them make the nuclear bomb; the Lord is behind everything, and it will come to light.

“That made the world as a wilderness, and destroyed the cities thereof”: by dropping bombs. You saw Palestine, and it is going to get worse; these cities will be destroyed. All of this is future prophecy, and it started in Palestine.

precepts.why: “How hath the Lord covered the daughter of Zion with a cloud in his anger, and cast down from heaven unto the earth the beauty of Israel”. Israel was cast down from heaven to the earth: brought down low, brought into captivity, no longer on top ruling. Heaven here is rulership, a place of authority. That is how Lucifer falls from heaven: cut down from ruling to the ground.

“Alas, alas, that great city Babylon, that mighty city! for in one hour is thy judgment come.” The king of Babylon in Isaiah 14 is that great city Babylon, that mighty city, and her judgment comes in one hour.

“For in one hour so great riches is come to nought.” That is the golden city: great riches. America is rich, and the golden city that ceases is America, Lucifer.

“I Jesus have sent mine angel to testify unto you these things in the churches. I am the root and the offspring of David, and the bright and morning star.” Christ is the morning star. So why is Lucifer, the king of Babylon, called son of the morning?

“I shall see him, but not now”. “There shall come a Star out of Jacob, and a Sceptre shall rise out of Israel”. The star comes out of Jacob, not out of Esau, and a ruler rises out of Israel. “And shall smite the corners of Moab, and destroy all the children of Sheth”: he shall smite the Moabites, the Chinese. The star out of Jacob is Christ.

“We have also a more sure word of prophecy; whereunto ye do well that ye take heed, as unto a light that shineth in a dark place, until the day dawn, and the day star arise in your hearts”. The day star is Christ, the bright morning star. So why is the king of Babylon, America, called Lucifer?

“For if he that cometh preacheth another Jesus, whom we have not preached”: someone came and taught another Jesus, one the apostles never taught. “Or if ye receive another spirit, which ye have not received”: another spirit is on the earth. “Or another gospel, which ye have not accepted”: another gospel is pushed on the earth, one we never accepted.

“For such are false apostles, deceitful workers, transforming themselves into the apostles of Christ.” That is why America is called the morning star: America transformed itself in the 1950s into a God-loving Christian nation. The white man came and taught another Christ and transformed himself into an apostle of Christ. That is what the antichrist has done. We are a God-fearing nation, a Christian nation, and we are here to set up righteousness and justice on the earth: that is what America has pushed for the last seventy years. That is why Christ says many shall come in my name and deceive many; it is speaking of Europe and America.

“And no marvel; for Satan himself is transformed into an angel of light.” “Therefore it is no great thing if his ministers also be transformed as the ministers of righteousness”. The white man transformed himself into a minister of righteousness, a God-fearing Christian society, after he murdered, stole, colonized and enslaved millions of people. That is why he is called the bright morning star, the son of the morning, in Isaiah 14:12: because he says he is a Christian society. But the real morning star is Christ.

“There was a man sent from God, whose name was John.” “The same came for a witness, to bear witness of the Light”: the Light is that bright morning star. “He was not that Light, but was sent to bear witness of that Light.” “That was the true Light”.

Why say the true Light? Because in the beginning Satan transformed himself into an angel of light. Christ is the true light, the bright morning star. Satan transformed himself, and his children have transformed themselves too, into apostles, into people of righteousness: we are righteous, a western society that teaches Jesus. No; that whole fourth beast is the antichrist system. They are Lucifer.

“And I beheld another beast coming up out of the earth; and he had two horns like a lamb”. This other beast rising up is America; he is Lucifer. The two horns are the Democrats and the Republicans. Why like a lamb? Christ is the lamb, and they transformed themselves into the people of Christ: we are a Christian-loving society.

“And he spake as a dragon”: he worships Satan, and everything he speaks is lies and blasphemy. “And he exerciseth all the power of the first beast before him”. Read on and he has a mark: it goes into America's economics, and into setting up the white Jesus on the earth. In these last days America is going to push Christianity hard, a Christianity 2.0, where if you do not worship the beast and follow American values, Judeo-Christian values, you won't be able to buy or sell.

“And at that time shall Michael stand up, the great prince which standeth for the children of thy people”. That time is Armageddon, when all nations rise up and fight against America, and Michael rises up to fight for us. “And there shall be a time of trouble, such as never was since there was a nation even to that same time: and at that time thy people shall be delivered”. Daniel's people shall be delivered. This is the kings of the nations raised up against Lucifer.

sense.text:
“And there was war in heaven”. Not war in the sky. Christians use this to say Lucifer fought with God and his angels; but heaven is rulership, and the war in heaven is all the nations fighting each other. “Michael and his angels fought against the dragon”: this is the time of trouble in Daniel 12, the same thing. “And the dragon fought and his angels”: the dragon that is fighting is Lucifer, America and Europe, and his angels are his armies.

The dragon is called Edom, the fourth beast; he is also called the devil and Satan. The war in heaven is Christ fighting the white man and his armies and destroying his kingdom. This is Lucifer falling from heaven: Michael and Christ and the angels fighting against Lucifer and destroying his kingdom.

“And prevailed not; neither was their place found any more in heaven.” They did not win against Michael and the angels. When Christ returns, Michael and the angels will fight against the white man and his army, and they will not have rulership on this earth any more.

“And the great dragon was cast out, that old serpent, called the Devil, and Satan, which deceiveth the whole world”. The one that deceives the whole world is not just a spiritual demon; it is his children: the white man, Edom, Lucifer, that transformed himself into an angel of light.

Read Revelation 19 at home: it is the same war, Christ fighting against the fourth beast, the antichrist, Lucifer, and taking him down from heaven.

precepts.why: The dragon fought, and his angels. “In that day the Lord with his sore and great and strong sword shall punish leviathan the piercing serpent, even leviathan that crooked serpent”: the piercing serpent is the white man. “And he shall slay the dragon that is in the sea”: that is America, the dragon in the sea. “In that day sing ye unto her, A vineyard of red wine.”

“Thou didst divide the sea by thy strength: thou brakest the heads of the dragons in the waters.” This is the dragon and his angels: Christ and Michael fighting against the white man and his army.

“Thou brakest the heads of leviathan in pieces, and gavest him to be meat to the people inhabiting the wilderness.” The heads of Leviathan are all the heads: Europe, France, America, all of them. Christ is going to destroy that dragon's whole government.

This explains the war in heaven. “And it shall come to pass in that day, that the Lord shall punish the host of the high ones that are on high”: the high ones on high are the people ruling. The Lord is going to punish Europe and America. “And the kings of the earth upon the earth”: he will punish the kings of the earth too. “And they shall be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit”.

“Come near, ye nations, to hear; and hearken, ye people”. “For the indignation of the Lord is upon all nations, and his fury upon all their armies”: the indignation is the Lord's anger upon all nations, and their armies are what Revelation calls the dragon's angels. “He hath utterly destroyed them, he hath delivered them to the slaughter.” “Their slain also shall be cast out, and their stink shall come up out of their carcases, and the mountains shall be melted with their blood.”

“And all the host of heaven shall be dissolved, and the heavens shall be rolled together as a scroll: and all their host shall fall down, as the leaf falleth off from the vine, and as a falling fig from the fig tree.”

“For my sword shall be bathed in heaven”. Is this heaven paradise? No: it is the governments of this world. And it makes plain who the heaven is, and who the dragon is in Revelation 12: “behold, it shall come down upon Idumea, and upon the people of my curse, to judgment.” The people of his curse are the son of perdition, the sons of destruction. The dragon is Idumea, Edom.
